comment: Contribution and tactic-label unit fixtures C01-Cnn (Planning/milestones/PostM2_EM1.md §9). Label unit; no engine.

Each fixture: id, title, source (Lichess puzzle ID 'lichess:<id>' (CC0), '<game>, before <move>' via chesswhy-pgn, or 'constructed'), fen, line_uci, margin, contributions, labels_include, labels_exclude.

line_uci: a tactic sequence from fen (X = the side to move at fen), already cut to its walked plies (M1 §4.3). margin: null for a Lichess puzzle solution; otherwise the only-move margin (ES, X's view) WP4 measured at budget standard, >= 0.13.

contributions: every X-side motif of position_motifs(fen) (ply 0) and line_motifs(fen, line_uci) (ply >= 1), each {tag, side, ply, actor, targets, contribution, reason}; a missing or extra X-side motif fails. contribution: 'direct'|'indirect'|'none', hand-labelled from the plain meaning of §4.3; reason: one line.

pin_tactical (§4.5) is exempt from the exact set (Captain, 2026-10-21): its entries also carry threat {kind, square}, are checked only where listed, and unlisted pin_tactical motifs neither fail nor match.
Motif fields as in motifs.json: tag (report spelling), side ('white'|'black'), ply, actor (square, e.g. 'e5'), targets (squares, in the order the motif reports them).

labels_include: each entry {tag, side, ply, actor, targets, reason} must appear in tactic_labels(fen, line_uci) with exactly these fields (reason excepted). labels_exclude: no label may match; omitted fields match anything.
Proposed by PostM2_EM1 WP4; frozen after the Captain's review (§12, checkpoint 1); labels change only at checkpoint 2.

fixtures.title: Queen check-fork guards the knight-capture square

contributions.reason: The pin on f6 does not change Qa4+, dxc6, or the resulting exchange.
The pin on the a7 pawn plays no part; the queen's guard of c6 is the queen's own work (Captain, checkpoint 2).
Qa4+ checks the king while attacking the bishop on b4.
dxc6 takes the hanging knight on c6.
The queen's pin includes the knight that dxc6 takes.
dxc6 captures the trapped knight.

fixtures.title: Discovered attack wins the exposed queen after checks

contributions.reason: Qxd5 moves the discovered attacker onto and captures the queen.
Qxd5 takes the hanging queen.

fixtures.title: Queen sacrifice clears the knight fork

contributions.reason: Ng4+ forks the king and queen, and Nxf6 takes the queen.
Nxf6 takes the hanging queen on f6.

fixtures.title: Rook fork forces the queen exchange

contributions.reason: Rf4+ forks the king and queen and forces the queen capture.
Qxf4 takes the white queen left on f4 after the rook exchange.

fixtures.title: Capture of the overloaded bishop wins the knight

contributions.reason: The pin does not affect either Rxf3 or Rxd5.
Rxf3 takes the overloaded bishop, then Rxd5 takes its knight target.
Rxd5 takes the hanging knight.

labels_include.reason: Rxf3 removes the bishop defending Nd5, and Rxd5 captures that knight.

fixtures.title: Knight capture removes the pawn guarding a knight

contributions.reason: Nxb2 removes the pawn defender and Qxc3 takes the knight it guarded.
Qxc3 takes the hanging knight.

labels_include.reason: Nxb2 removes the pawn protecting Nc3, which Qxc3 then wins.

fixtures.title: Queen sacrifice removes the rook's defender

contributions.reason: Qxd7 takes the guarding queen, and Rxc8 takes its rook target.
Rxc8 takes the hanging rook.

labels_include.reason: Qxd7 removes the queen defending Rc8, then Rxc8 captures that rook.

fixtures.title: Overloaded queen leaves the bishop on b6 exposed

contributions.reason: Bxb6 takes one of the queen's protected targets.
Rb8 pins the bishop to the queen, and Bxb6 later captures the bishop.
Bxb6 takes the queen's protected bishop target.
Bxb6 captures the hanging bishop.

labels_include.reason: dxc5 removes the pawn defending Bb6; the queen alone cannot hold d3 and b6, and Bxb6 wins the bishop (Captain, checkpoint 2).

fixtures.title: Queen and knight overwhelm the pawn's two duties

contributions.reason: Qxh4 dissolves this pin; the g3 pawn is held by the threat Nxf4+, not by the queen (Captain, checkpoint 2).
Qxh4 takes the rook target and Nxf4 wins the pawn target.
The h4 rook guards f4 against the Nf4 fork; Qxh4 captures it.
The g3 pawn guards f4 against the Nf4 fork; Nxe2 later captures the forked queen.
Nxf4+ forks the queen and king.
Nxe2 takes the hanging queen.

labels_include.reason: Qxh4 removes the rook defending f4, gxh4 pulls away the pawn, its other defender, and Nxf4+ follows (Captain, checkpoint 2).

fixtures.title: Sacrificial rook check leads to mate

contributions.reason: The knight on d4 is not used by Rxh7+ or Qh5#.
Rxh7+ captures the pinned pawn and opens the mating attack.
Kxh7 removes the rook before the pin can affect Qh5#.
The later hanging-knight state is irrelevant to the mate.

fixtures.title: Queen trade removes the knight's defender

contributions.reason: Bxe4 takes the hanging knight.
The bishop's new pin appears after the last tactic move and is not used.

labels_include.reason: Qxf4 removes the queen defending Ne4, and Bxe4 later captures the knight.

fixtures.title: Pinned pawn cannot recapture the bishop on d6

contributions.reason: Bxd6 captures the hanging queen.
The e-file pin stops the pawn on e7 from recapturing Bxd6.
The later pin on e5 does not affect the remaining capture or king move.
The e4 pin does not change Kf2 or the tactic's result.
The final pawn pin appears after the last white move.

fixtures.title: Pinned knight cannot recapture the bishop on f5

contributions.reason: Bxf5 captures the hanging queen.
The e-file pin makes Nxf5 illegal, so the bishop cannot be recaptured.

fixtures.title: Pinned pawn cannot recapture the bishop on d6 from c7

contributions.reason: Bxd6 captures the hanging queen.
The c-file pin prevents the pawn from recapturing the bishop on d6.

fixtures.title: T33 revival: pawn removes the bishop defending a knight

contributions.reason: cxd6 captures the hanging bishop.
Rxe5 moves the pinning rook and captures the pinned knight.
After cxd6, Rxe5 captures the trapped knight.
Rxe5 takes the hanging knight.

labels_include.reason: cxd6 removes the bishop defending Ne5, then Rxe5 captures the knight.

fixtures.title: T34 near miss: the rook still defends the knight

contributions.reason: cxd6 captures the hanging bishop.
Re2 regroups along the file without using the pin (Captain, checkpoint 2).
After Re2, the remaining White king move to b1 is not attacked by the pin's pieces.

fixtures.title: Back-rank pawns deny the king an escape from Re8#

contributions.reason: The pawns on f7, g7, and h7 deny Kf7, Kg7, and Kh7, which would escape Re8+ if each blocker were removed.
Re8# directly delivers the checkmate represented by this motif.
The queen on g7 attacks f7 and h7, so removing the blockers gives the king no answer to Qxg7#.
